column1: AN ACT TO AMEND THE PROVINCIAL COUNCILS ACT, NO. 42    OF 1987
BE it  enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

column2: This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Provincial  Councils
Section 25 of the Provincial Councils Act, No. 42 of

column1: 1987 is hereby amended in subsection (1) of that section by
the  substitution  for  the  words  “three  months  before  the
commencement of such financial year”, of the words “one
month before the commencement of such financial year”.

column2: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala

column1: and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
